associations.rationale: torComparison returns an isomorphism between TorByResolution for arbitrary resolutions P and Q in every degree, directly giving comparison isomorphisms.
torComparison_refl states that the comparison isomorphism for a resolution with itself has identity hom, the required identity law.
torComparison_trans states that composing P-to-Q and Q-to-R comparison maps equals the P-to-R comparison map, the required composition law.
torLiftMap_eq_comparison identifies a map induced by a chosen compatible lift with the canonical comparison map; it supports its construction rather than stating an isomorphism or its laws.
